message.content:
Here are some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (in no particular order). These movies were praised for their suspenseful storytelling, strong performances, and engaging twists.

| Film | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror tale that blends psychological thriller elements with a tense cat‑and‑mouse chase. |
| **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II | A courtroom drama that doubles as a thriller, with sharp dialogue and a tense atmosphere. |
| **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A crime epic that uses time‑jumping storytelling to build suspense over decades. |
| **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A psychological thriller that follows a man who becomes the target of a hunt, blending crime and paranoia. |
| **The Night House** | David Bruckner | Rebecca Hall, Nathan Lane | A supernatural thriller that keeps viewers on edge with its eerie atmosphere and plot twists. |
| **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime thriller that builds tension through a duel and a courtroom showdown. |
| **The Woman in the Window** | Andrew Jarecki | Amy Adams, James McAvoy | A psychological thriller that plays with unreliable narration and suspenseful pacing. |
| **The Little Things** | John Lee Hancock | Denzel Washington, Rami Malek, Jared Leto | A crime thriller that follows two detectives on a hunt for a serial killer, with a tense cat‑and‑mouse dynamic. |
| **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror tale that blends psychological thriller elements with a tense cat‑and‑mouse chase. |
| **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A psychological thriller that follows a man who becomes the target of a hunt, blending crime and paranoia. |

These films showcase a range of styles—from psychological thrillers to courtroom dramas—while maintaining a focus on crime and suspense. If you’re looking for a gripping crime‑thriller from 2020, any of these titles would be a solid choice.
